 ROANOKE, Va. (WSET) — About 30 people were displaced Sunday following a fire at a Roanoke apartment complex, according to firefighters.
 At 3:45 a.m., crews with the Roanoke Fire & EMS Department were called to the 2300 block of Tuckawana Circle NW for a report of a structure fire.
 First responders reported finding heavy fire coming from the roof of the apartment complex.
 SEE ALSO: Hiker rescued from Sharp Top Mountain with non-life-threatening injuries 
 The road was blocked while crews worked. The department said the fire was marked under control at 5:29 a.m.
 The cause of the fire is still under investigation. ABC13 will update when we know more.
